import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst, rev;
        long flow, cap;
        int cost;
        Edge(int src, int dst, int rev, long flow, long cap, int cost) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MinFlowCost {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        long[] pi;
        long[] dist;
        Edge[] parent;

        MinFlowCost(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            pi = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            parent = new Edge[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int s, int t, long cap, int cst) {
            graph.get(s).add(new Edge(s, t, graph.get(t).size(), 0, cap, cst));
            graph.get(t).add(new Edge(t, s, graph.get(s).size() - 1, 0, 0, -cst));
        }

        long get_rcost(Edge e) {
            return e.cost + pi[e.src] - pi[e.dst];
        }

        final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        long runDijkstra(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
            dist[s] = 0;
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] top = pq.poll();
                long d = top[0];
                int u = (int) top[1];
                if (d > dist[u]) continue;
                if (u == t) break;
                for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.dst] > dist[u] + get_rcost(e)) {
                        parent[e.dst] = e;
                        dist[e.dst] = dist[u] + get_rcost(e);
                        pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t];
        }

        long[] maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long totalFlow = 0;
            long totalCost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pi, 0);
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0);
            Arrays.fill(parent, null);
            while (runDijkstra(s, t) < INF) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    if (dist[u] < dist[t]) {
                        pi[u] += dist[u] - dist[t];
                    }
                }
                long flowCap = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                for (Edge e = parent[t]; e != null; e = parent[e.src]) {
                    flowCap = Math.min(flowCap, e.cap - e.flow);
                }
                for (Edge e = parent[t]; e != null; e = parent[e.src]) {
                    e.flow += flowCap;
                    graph.get(e.dst).get(e.rev).flow -= flowCap;
                }
                totalFlow += flowCap;
                totalCost += flowCap * (pi[t] - pi[s]);
            }
            return new long[]{totalFlow, totalCost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int totalNodes = (n + 2) * 102;
        MinFlowCost g = new MinFlowCost(totalNodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < 102; i++) {
            int from = (i * (n + 2)) + 1;
            int to = i * (n + 2);
            g.addEdge(from, to, 100, i * c);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                int from = j + (i * (n + 2));
                int to = j + ((i + 1) * (n + 2));
                g.addEdge(from, to, 100, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            g.addEdge(n + 1, u, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < 101; j++) {
                for (int f = 0; f < k; f++) {
                    int fromU = u + (j * (n + 2));
                    int toV = v + ((j + 1) * (n + 2));
                    int fromV = v + (j * (n + 2));
                    int toU = u + ((j + 1) * (n + 2));
                    int costVal = ((2 * f) + 1) * d;
                    g.addEdge(fromU, toV, 1, costVal);
                    g.addEdge(fromV, toU, 1, costVal);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] result = g.maxFlow(n + 1, (101 * (n + 2)));
        System.out.println(result[1]);
    }
}
